description: Run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Only the npm dependencies are refreshed: the actions, the Docker base image and the Node version stay manual.
The workflow runs once inside the Monday window, so that run opens every weekly pull request: no hourly or concurrent cap.

The release age and its exemptions are the minimumReleaseAge settings of pnpm-workspace.yaml. pnpm enforces them on every install, lock file maintenance included, and Renovate reads them to wait as long before it proposes an update.

The label and the body make the pull request pass the PR check as opened (tools/release/check-pr.ts). Every template heading comes before the release notes, the part Renovate cuts from a body that is too long.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix arrives with the next weekly refresh, not in a pull request of its own outside the schedule.

packageRules.description: Node and pnpm are also set in the workflows, the Dockerfile and .nvmrc, and move with them by hand.
Each override in pnpm-workspace.yaml is kept by hand for the parent named on its line. Lock file maintenance moves the ranged ones.
The home repo pin moves only with `pnpm home:bump`, which also rewrites its allowBuilds key (tools/home/CONTEXT.md).
react-doctor is a pnpm project of its own, bumped by hand after a full scan (tools/react-doctor/CONTEXT.md).
A beta of a types package is pinned by hand (the publish-beta-types skill), and its builds are named by a commit hash, not ordered. Leaving it for a stable release is a major.
Major updates and package replacements are opened only when someone asks for them on the Dependency Dashboard.
By semver a 0.x minor bump may break, like a major, while Renovate counts it as a minor. Keeping it apart from the patches lets the patches still arrive while it waits.
A 0.x minor bump is opened only on request, like a major.

description: Patches and minors arrive weekly in one pull request, except the wallet stack's (below).
The branch is named here, not from the group slug, which gets a patch- prefix for a 0.x patch kept apart from its minor.

packageRules.description: Minors join it, except a 0.x minor bump and the wallet stack's.

description: The wallet stack stays out of the weekly pull request, patches included: patches/@lifi__widget-light@4.3.2.patch and the peerDependencyRules of pnpm-workspace.yaml are written against exact wagmi and viem versions.
wagmi, viem, Reown AppKit and WalletConnect move together in one pull request: AppKit pins exact versions of its own packages and of WalletConnect, and takes wagmi and viem as peers.
@lifi/widget-light gets a pull request of its own: each of its bumps means redoing its patch, which would hold the rest back.
